 "description": "Offers an overview of research methodologies for ASL or interpreting majors preparing for their research capstone projects. Focuses on foundational theoretical knowledge and skills in research design, hypothesis testing, sampling and measurement, research ethics with deaf populations, as well as basic data analysis and interpretation.
